questions.question:
Create a Pod named `web-pod` in the existing `quick-pods` namespace.

Use the image `nginx:1.27.5` and add the labels `app=web` and `env=practice`. Ensure the Pod is Running and Ready.

Suggested time: 5 minutes. Marks: 20.

verification.description: Pod has the required image and labels and is Running and Ready

questions.question:
Create a Deployment named `frontend` in the existing `quick-deployments` namespace.

Use the image `nginx:1.27.5`, set the replica count to `3`, and give the Pod template the label `app=frontend`. Ensure all three replicas are ready.

Suggested time: 6 minutes. Marks: 20.

verification.description: Deployment has three ready replicas with the required image and Pod label

questions.question:
A Deployment named `backend` is already running in the `quick-services` namespace. Its Pods have the label `app=backend` and serve HTTP on container port `80`.

Create a Service named `backend-svc` in this namespace. Set its type to `ClusterIP`, use the selector `app=backend`, and expose TCP port `8080`, targeting port `80`.

Suggested time: 5 minutes. Marks: 20.

verification.description: ClusterIP Service selects the backend and maps TCP port 8080 to port 80

questions.question:
In the existing `quick-config` namespace, create a ConfigMap named `app-config` with the key `APP_MODE` set to `practice`.

Create a Pod named `config-pod` using image `busybox:1.37.0`. Keep it running with the command `sh -c 'sleep 3600'`. Set its environment variable `APP_MODE` using a `configMapKeyRef` to the `APP_MODE` key in `app-config` (do not hard-code the value in the Pod). Ensure the environment variable is available inside the running container.

Suggested time: 8 minutes. Marks: 20.

verification.description: ConfigMap is consumed through configMapKeyRef and APP_MODE is available in the container

questions.question:
Create a Job named `batch-check` in the existing `quick-jobs` namespace using image `busybox:1.37.0`.

The Job must print `job-complete` and exit successfully. Set `completions` to `1`, `parallelism` to `1`, and the Pod restart policy to `Never`. Wait for the Job to complete and leave the Job and its Pod in place for grading.

Suggested time: 6 minutes. Marks: 20.

verification.description: Job has the required settings, completes successfully, and logs job-complete
